description: See what a domain points at today, from public DNS: its nameservers and DNS provider, the web target (apex and www records and the service they match), the mail provider (MX, SPF, DMARC) and the DNSSEC state. Use it before suggesting changes, to explain the current setup, or to check that new records are live. Works for any domain; read-only.

domain.description: The domain itself, e.g. example.no (Unicode such as blåbær.no is fine). Any registrar, any DNS provider.

name: check_pointing
title: What a domain points at today
